learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to collect information, use tally marks, and make data tables while keeping our village clean!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Data is just a fancy word for information! When we count how many dustbins or trees are in our village, we are collecting data.
Instead of writing numbers again and again, we draw straight lines called tally marks. For every 5th item, we draw a slanting line across four straight lines to make a bundle!
We put our collected data into neat boxes called tables. Tables make it very easy to read and understand who collected the most dry leaves or planted the most trees.

fun_activity.title: 🧹 Home Cleaning Data
fun_activity.instructions: Make a small table in your notebook. Count and use tally marks to record how many brooms, mops, and dustbins you have in your house!

quick_recap: ⭐ Collecting numbers and information about things is called gathering data.
⭐ Tally marks help us count things quickly in bundles of five.
⭐ Data tables keep our information neat, clean, and easy to read.
